description: This file defines an internal API for reading and writing TensorFlow SavedModel protobufs, including functions for serialization to files and strings, as well as chunked proto support.

methods.name: ReadSavedModel
methods.description: Reads the SavedModel protobuf from a file prefix, handling both .pb and .cpb files, and returns a status indicating success or failure.

methods.name: WriteSavedModel
methods.description: Serializes a SavedModel protobuf to a file, supporting both protobuf binary and chunked formats, based on size.

methods.name: WriteSavedModelToString
methods.description: Serializes a SavedModel protobuf to a string, indicating whether it is chunked or not.

methods.name: WriteSavedModelToCord
methods.description: Serializes a SavedModel protobuf to an absl::Cord object, used for efficient string handling in some environments.

methods.name: WriteSavedModel (overload with debug_max_size)
methods.description: Serializes a SavedModel protobuf to a file with a specified maximum size for testing purposes.
